collection.description: Children find a trail of tiny painted pebbles that adults walking the main path have never noticed.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Children find a trail of tiny painted pebbles that adults walking the main path have never noticed.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The trail leads to an old, harmless play circle hidden by grass.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The trail ends at a shallow puddle; the children deduce the remaining stones washed away.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) recognizes the symbols as marks from a recent game.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) notices that some paint is much older than the rest, raising a historical question.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The children document the pattern with drawings for later comparison.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They agree to protect the site and instead build a new trail for their own games.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The children produce a surprisingly accurate miniature map of the clearing.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
